verses.sloka: ततः सकपिशार्दूलस्तेन वाक्येन हर्षितः ।सीतामुवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वाक्यं वक्यविशारदः ।। ५.३८.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sakapiśārdūlastena vākyena harṣitaḥ ।sītāmuvāca tacchrutvā vākyaṁ vakyaviśāradaḥ ।। 5.38.1।।।।

translations.english: Satisfied with the words of Sita, the tiger among monkeys, who was eloquent in speech said:
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्ड का उनतालीसवाँ सगं पूरा हुआ । 0-7; गह | चत्वारिंशः सगः शृत्वा तु वचनं तस्य वायसूनोसंहात्मन; । उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं सीता मुरसुतोपसा

verses.sloka: युक्तरूपं त्वया देवि भाषितं शुभदर्शने ।सदृशं स्त्रीस्वभावस्य साध्वीनां विनयस्य च ।। ५.३८.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: yuktarūpaṁ tvayā devi bhāṣitaṁ śubhadarśane ।sadṛśaṁ strīsvabhāvasya sādhvīnāṁ vinayasya ca ।। 5.38.2।।।।

translations.english: "O queen O lady of auspicious appearance your words are most appropriate to and characteristic of a modest virtuous woman.
translations.hindi: हे वानर | तुझ प्यारे वचन बोलने वाले को देख, मुझे वैसा ही हषं प्राप्त हुषा है जैसा कि श्राघे उगे धान्य से युक्त पृथिवी को जलवृष्टि से होता है

verses.sloka: स्त्रीत्वं न तु समर्थं हि सागरं व्यतिवर्तितुम् ।मामधिष्ठाय विस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम् ।। ५.३८.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: strītvaṁ na tu samarthaṁ hi sāgaraṁ vyativartitum ।māmadhiṣṭhāya vistīrṇaṁ śatayojanamāyatam ।। 5.38.3।।।।

translations.english: "It may not be possible for a woman to cross on my back the vast ocean stretching over a hundred yojanas. It is not possible for a woman.
translations.hindi: तुम मेरे ऊपर दया करके ऐसा करना कि जिससे उत्कट इच्छा रखने बाली में शोककषित उन पुरुषसिह श्रीरामचंद्रजी से मिल-भेंट सक"

verses.sloka: द्वितीयं कारणं यच्च ब्रवीषि विनयान्विते ।रामादन्यस्य नार्हामि संस्पर्शमिति जानकि ।। ५.३८.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: dvitīyaṁ kāraṇaṁ yacca bravīṣi vinayānvite ।rāmādanyasya nārhāmi saṁsparśamiti jānaki ।। 5.38.4।।।।

translations.english: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?
translations.hindi: हे वानरोत्तमं ! तुम श्रीरामचन्द्रजी को उस काक की आँख फोड़ने वाली पहचान अवश्य बतला देना और यह कह देना कि जब एक बार मेरा तिलक सिट गया था तब तुमने मेरे गालों पर मेनसिल का तिलक लगा दिया था सो इसका भी स्मरण करो

verses.sloka: एतत्ते देवि सदृशं पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः ।का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद्वचनमीदृशम् ।। ५.३८.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: etatte devi sadṛśaṁ patnyāstasya mahātmanaḥ ।kā hyanyā tvāmṛte devi brūyādvacanamīdṛśam ।। 5.38.5।।।।

translations.english: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?

verses.sloka: श्रोष्यते चैव काकुत्स्थः सर्वं निरवशेषतः ।चोष्टितं यत्त्वया देवि भाषितं मम चाग्रतः ।। ५.३८.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: śroṣyate caiva kākutsthaḥ sarvaṁ niravaśeṣataḥ ।coṣṭitaṁ yattvayā devi bhāṣitaṁ mama cāgrataḥ ।। 5.38.6।।।।

translations.english: "O queen Kakutstha Rama will hear from me fully all that has been said and done by you in my presence without any omission.

verses.sloka: कारणैर्बहुभिर्देवि रामप्रियचिकीर्षया ।स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा मयैतत् समुदीरितम् ।। ५.३८.७।।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāraṇairbahubhirdevi rāmapriyacikīrṣayā ।snehapraskannamanasā mayaitat samudīritam ।। 5.38.7।।।।।

translations.english: "O queen my heart is drenched with love for Rama and desires to please him for many reasons. Therefore these words have been spoken by me.
translations.hindi: देखो, यह दिव्य चूडामणि, मेंने अपने पास बड़े यत्न से रख छोड़ी थी और इसे जब देखती तब इस दुःख में भी मुझे वंसा ही आनन्द ग्राप्त होता था जैसा तुम्हें प्रत्यक्ष देखने से होता है

verses.sloka: लङ्काया दुष्प्रवेशत्वाद् दुस्तरत्वान्महोदधेः ।सामर्थ्यादात्मनश्चैव मयैतत् समुदीरितम् ।। ५.३८.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: laṅkāyā duṣpraveśatvād dustaratvānmahodadheḥ ।sāmarthyādātmanaścaiva mayaitat samudīritam ।। 5.38.8।।।।

translations.english: "Crossing the ocean and entering Lanka are difficult. But I accomplished it. Hence my proposal.
translations.hindi: यहाँ मुझे भ्रसह्म दुःख झेलने पड़ते हैं भ्रौर भयंकर राक्षसियो के मर्ममेदी वचनः सुनने पड़ते हे । ये तुम्हारे लिए ही में सह रही हूँ

verses.sloka: इच्छामि त्वां समानेतुमद्यैव रघुबन्धुना ।गुरुस्नेहेन भक्त्या च नान्यथैतदुदाहृतम् ।। ५.३८.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: icchāmi tvāṁ samānetumadyaiva raghubandhunā ।gurusnehena bhaktyā ca nānyathaitadudāhṛtam ।। 5.38.9।।।।

translations.english: "I offered to take you today itself out of my love and devotion to Rama with a desire to unite you with him and not with any other intention.

verses.sloka: यदि नोत्सहसे यातुं मया सार्धमनिन्दिते ।अभिज्ञानं प्रयच्छ त्वं जानीयाद्राघवो हि तत् ।। ५.३८.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi notsahase yātuṁ mayā sārdhamanindite ।abhijñānaṁ prayaccha tvaṁ jānīyādrāghavo hi tat ।। 5.38.10।।।।

translations.english: "O blameless lady If you wish not to accompany me you may give me a token of identification to let Rama know about my coming here and seeing you".
translations.hindi: हे शत्रुसूदन ! श्रव से एक मास तक श्रौर मैं तुम्हारी बाठ जोहती हुई जीवित रहूँगी । हे राजकुमार ! एक मास बीतने के बाद तुम्हारे दर्शन न हुए तो में प्राण त्याग दूंगी

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता सुरसुतोपमा ।उवाच वचनं मन्दं बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम् ।। ५.३८.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktā hanumatā sītā surasutopamā ।uvāca vacanaṁ mandaṁ bāṣpapragrathitākṣaram ।। 5.38.11।।।।

translations.english: Having heard Hanuman, Sita, a child of god, said these words in a low tone. Choked with tears, 'Carry this token of identity to my dear husband':
translations.hindi: राक्षस राज रावण ग्रत्यन्त निठर है । मुझे इसकी सूरत देखना भी ग्रच्छा नहीं लगता । यदि तुमने यहाँ प्राने में बिलम्ब किया र यह बात मैंने सुनी, तो एक क्षण भी में जीवित न रहूंगी

verses.sloka: इदं श्रेष्ठमभिज्ञानं ब्रूयास्त्वं तु मम प्रियम्।शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा ।। ५.३८.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: idaṁ śreṣṭhamabhijñānaṁ brūyāstvaṁ tu mama priyam।śailasya citrakūṭasya pāde pūrvottare purā ।। 5.38.12।।।।

translations.english: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.
translations.hindi: जानकोजी के रुदनपूवंक कहे हुए इन वचनों को सुन, महा तेजस्वी पवन- नन्दन हनुमानजी कहने लगे

verses.sloka: तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः प्राज्यमूलफलोदके ।तस्मिन् सिद्धाश्रमे देशे मन्दाकिन्या ह्यदूरतः ।। ५.३८.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāpasāśramavāsinyāḥ prājyamūlaphalodake ।tasmin siddhāśrame deśe mandākinyā hyadūrataḥ ।। 5.38.13।।।।

translations.english: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.
translations.hindi: हे देवि ! में शपथपूर्वक सत्य-सत्य कहता हैं कि, श्रीरामचंद्रजी तुम्हारे वियोग-जन्य-शोक से उदास हूँ भौर उनकी दशा देख लक्ष्मण भी संतप्त रहा करते हूँ

verses.sloka: तस्योपवनषण्डेषु नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु ।विहृत्य सलिलक्लिन्ना तवाङ्के समुपाविशम् ।। ५.३८.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasyopavanaṣaṇḍeṣu nānāpuṣpasugandhiṣu ।vihṛtya salilaklinnā tavāṅke samupāviśam ।। 5.38.14।।।।

translations.english: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.
translations.hindi: संयोगवश मेने किसी तरह अब तुमको देख पाया है । सो श्रब हे भामिनी ! भव तुम शीघ्र ही इन दुःखों का अन्त देखोगी भ्र्थात्‌ दुःखों से छट जाग्नोगी

verses.sloka: ततो मांससमायुक्तो वायसः पर्यतुण्डयत् ।तमहं लोष्टमुद्यम्य वारयामि स्म वायसम् ।। ५.३८.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato māṁsasamāyukto vāyasaḥ paryatuṇḍayat ।tamahaṁ loṣṭamudyamya vārayāmi sma vāyasam ।। 5.38.15।।।।

translations.english: 'Then a crow greedy of flesh began to peck my bossom with its beak. I took a clod of earth and warded him off.

verses.sloka: दारयन् स च मां काकस्तत्रैव परिलीयते ।न चाप्युपारमन्मांसाद्भक्षार्थी बलिभोजनः ।। ५.३८.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: dārayan sa ca māṁ kākastatraiva parilīyate ।na cāpyupāramanmāṁsādbhakṣārthī balibhojanaḥ ।। 5.38.16।।।।

translations.english: 'The crow was an eater of offerings, hungry for food began to peck me again and again for flesh.He did not stop.

verses.sloka: उत्कर्षन्त्यां च रशनां क्रुद्धायां मयि पक्षिणि ।स्रस्यमाने च वसने ततो दृष्टा त्वया ह्यहम् ।। ५.३८.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: utkarṣantyāṁ ca raśanāṁ kruddhāyāṁ mayi pakṣiṇi ।srasyamāne ca vasane tato dṛṣṭā tvayā hyaham ।। 5.38.17।।।।

translations.english: 'My upper cloth was slipping. I was trying to pull up my waist string angrily when you saw me.

verses.sloka: त्वया ऽपहसिता चाहं क्रुद्धा संलज्जिता तदा ।भक्षगृध्रेन काकेन दारिता त्वामुपागता ।। ५.३८.१८।।.३८.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvayā 'pahasitā cāhaṁ kruddhā saṁlajjitā tadā ।bhakṣagṛdhrena kākena dāritā tvāmupāgatā ।। 5.38.18।।.38.17।।।।

translations.english: 'Then you made fun of me, and I became angry. I was abashed. Torn by the voracious bird I sought your shelter.
translations.hindi: इस पर सीताजी कहने लगीं, हे वीर ! मेने तुमको यह श्रेष्ठ चूडामणि चिन्ह्वानी दी है, जिसको देख

verses.sloka: आसीनस्य च ते श्रान्ता पुनरुत्सङ्गमाविशम् ।क्रुद्ध्यन्ती च प्रहृष्टेन त्वया ऽहं परिसान्त्विता ।। ५.३८.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: āsīnasya ca te śrāntā punarutsaṅgamāviśam ।kruddhyantī ca prahṛṣṭena tvayā 'haṁ parisāntvitā ।। 5.38.19।।।।

translations.english: 'Exhausted, I sat on your lap again. Seeing my angry face you pacified me. You were happy (to see me draw close).

verses.sloka: बाष्पपूर्णमुखी मन्दं चक्षुषी परिमार्जती ।लक्षिता ऽहं त्वया नाथ वायसेन प्रकोपिता ।। ५.३८.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: bāṣpapūrṇamukhī mandaṁ cakṣuṣī parimārjatī ।lakṣitā 'haṁ tvayā nātha vāyasena prakopitā ।। 5.38.20।।।।

translations.english: 'O lord when I was angered by the crow and my face was filled with tears, you marked me wiping my eyes.
translations.hindi: प्रौर जानकीजी को सीस नवा कर प्रणाम कर, वहाँ से चलने को तैयार हुए। हनुमानजी को छलांग मारने के लिए तैयार ग्रौर बड़ी तेजी के साथ दारीर को बढ़ाते हुए देख, सीताजी भ्रांखों में आँसु भर गद्गद कण्ठ स्रे बोलीं !

verses.sloka: परिश्रमात् प्रसुप्ता च राघवाङ्के ऽप्यहं चिरम् ।पर्यायेण प्रसुप्तश्च ममाङ्के भरताग्रजः ।स तत्र पुनरेवाथ वायसः समुपागमत् ।। ५.३८.२१।।।।
verses.transliteration: pariśramāt prasuptā ca rāghavāṅke 'pyahaṁ ciram ।paryāyeṇa prasuptaśca mamāṅke bharatāgrajaḥ ।sa tatra punarevātha vāyasaḥ samupāgamat ।। 5.38.21।।।।

translations.english: 'Totally exhausted I slept on your lap for a long time, and in turn you slept on my lap later.

verses.sloka: ततः सुप्तप्रबुद्धां मां रामस्याङ्कात् समुत्थिताम् ।वायसः सहसा ऽ ऽगम्य विददार स्तनान्तरे ।। ५.३८.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suptaprabuddhāṁ māṁ rāmasyāṅkāt samutthitām ।vāyasaḥ sahasā ' 'gamya vidadāra stanāntare ।। 5.38.22।।।।

translations.english: 'The crow came back again and clawed me in the space between my breasts even after I woke up after slumber from Rama's lap. Flying, it tore my bosom again and again.

verses.sloka: पुनः पुनरथोत्पत्य विददार स मां भृशम् ।ततः समुक्षितो रामो मुक्तैः शोणितबिन्दुभिः ।। ५.३८.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: punaḥ punarathotpatya vidadāra sa māṁ bhṛśam ।tataḥ samukṣito rāmo muktaiḥ śoṇitabindubhiḥ ।। 5.38.23।।।।

translations.english: 'The crow came back again and clawed me in the space between my breasts even after I woke up after slumber from Rama's lap. Flying, it tore my bosom again and again.

verses.sloka: वायसेन ततस्तेन बलवत्क्लिश्यमानया ।स मया बोधितः श्रीमान् सुखसुप्तः परन्तपः ।। ५.३८.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: vāyasena tatastena balavatkliśyamānayā ।sa mayā bodhitaḥ śrīmān sukhasuptaḥ parantapaḥ ।। 5.38.24।।।।

translations.english: 'At the touch of the drops of blood dripping from my body, tormented by seeing me distressed with the dripping blood, you were awakened, you who were an illustrious scorcher of foes.
translations.hindi: र है कपिश्नेष्ठ ! मेरे इस तीव्र झोक के वेग का तथा राक्षप्तो द्वारा मेरी डुदशा का वृत्तांत तुम श्रीरामचन््रजी के पास जाकर कह देना । मे प्राशीर्वाड देती हूँ कि, तुम्हारी यात्रा तिदिष्न पूरी हो

verses.sloka: स मां दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्वितुन्नां स्तनयोस्तदा ।आशीविष इव क्रुद्धः श्वसन् वाक्यमभाषत ।। ५.३८.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa māṁ dṛṣṭvā mahābāhurvitunnāṁ stanayostadā ।āśīviṣa iva kruddhaḥ śvasan vākyamabhāṣata ।। 5.38.25।।।।

translations.english: 'O strongarmed Rama, seeing my torn breasts, you became angry like a hissing serpent and hissing said :

verses.sloka: केन ते नागनासोरु विक्षतं वै स्तनान्तरम् ।कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ।। ५.३८.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: kena te nāganāsoru vikṣataṁ vai stanāntaram ।kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā ।। 5.38.26।।।।

translations.english: 'O Sita with a beautiful lap like an elephant trunk by whom is your bosom wounded? Who is sporting with an angry fivehooded snake?

verses.sloka: वीक्षमाणस्ततस्तं वै वायसं समुदैक्षत ।नखैः सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम् ।। ५.३८.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: vīkṣamāṇastatastaṁ vai vāyasaṁ samudaikṣata ।nakhaiḥ sarudhiraistīkṣṇairmāmevābhimukhaṁ sthitam ।। 5.38.27।।।।

translations.english: 'Then looking around, you saw the crow facing me with sharp, bloodstained claws.

verses.sloka: पुत्रः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः ।धरान्तरगतः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः ।। ५.३८.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: putraḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṁ varaḥ ।dharāntaragataḥ śīghraṁ pavanasya gatau samaḥ ।। 5.38.28।।।।

translations.english: 'This crow was the best of birds. He was surely Indra's son who had covered a long distance with great speed and his speed was like the Windgod's.

verses.sloka: ततस्तस्मिन् महाबाहुः कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः ।वायसे कृतवान् क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वरः ।। ५.३८.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastasmin mahābāhuḥ kopasaṁvartitekṣaṇaḥ ।vāyase kṛtavān krūrāṁ matiṁ matimatāṁ varaḥ ।। 5.38.29।।।।

translations.english: 'Then you, the strongarmed and best among the wise, your eyeballs rolling in fury, made up your mind about the cruel crow.

verses.sloka: स दर्भं संस्तराद् गृह्य ब्राह्मेमास्त्रेण योजयत् ।स दीप्त इव कालाग्रिर्जज्वलाभिमुखो द्विजम् ।। ५.३८.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa darbhaṁ saṁstarād gṛhya brāhmemāstreṇa yojayat ।sa dīpta iva kālāgrirjajvalābhimukho dvijam ।। 5.38.30।।।।

translations.english: 'Taking out a blade of darbha grass from your mat, you invoked the weapon of Brahma by reciting the mantra. Then you discharged it which blazed like the fire of death and went spearheading towards the crow.

verses.sloka: स तं प्रदीप्तं चिक्षेप दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति ।ततस्तं वायसं दर्भः सो ऽम्बरे ऽनुजगाम ह ।। ५.३८.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ pradīptaṁ cikṣepa darbhaṁ taṁ vāyasaṁ prati ।tatastaṁ vāyasaṁ darbhaḥ so 'mbare 'nujagāma ha ।। 5.38.31।।।।

translations.english: 'Then you threw the burning darbha grass at the crow and it chased him in the sky.

verses.sloka: अनुसृप्तस्तदा काको जगाम विविधां गतिम् ।लोककाम इमं लोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह ।। ५.३८.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: anusṛptastadā kāko jagāma vividhāṁ gatim ।lokakāma imaṁ lokaṁ sarvaṁ vai vicacāra ha ।। 5.38.32।।।।

translations.english: 'Then that crow flew to many places seeking asylum all over the universe chased by the blade of grass.

verses.sloka: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तः सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः ।त्रील्लोकान् संपरिक्रम्य तमेव शरणं गतः ।। ५.३८.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa pitrā ca parityaktaḥ suraiśca samaharṣibhiḥ ।trīllokān saṁparikramya tameva śaraṇaṁ gataḥ ।। 5.38.33।।।।

translations.english: 'Then the crow went round all the three worlds, having been rejected by his father Indra, including all the sages and gods. Refused by all he came back to Rama seeking shelter.

verses.sloka: स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यः शरणागतम् ।वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थः कृपया पर्यपालयत् ।। ५.३८.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ nipatitaṁ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam ।vadhārhamapi kākutsthaḥ kṛpayā paryapālayat ।। 5.38.34।।।।

translations.english: 'Seeing the crow fallen on the ground, O Kakutstha, you who are a saviour of those who seek refuge saved him out of compassion, even though he deserved to be killed.

verses.sloka: न शर्म लब्ध्वा तमेव शरणं गतः ।। ५.३८.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: na śarma labdhvā tameva śaraṇaṁ gataḥ ।। 5.38.35।।।।

translations.english: 'Rama, you saw the crow in pain and despondency who returned to you and said that it is not possible to make Brahma's weapon ineffectual.You may tell now. (what should be done.)

verses.sloka: परिद्यूनं विषण्णं च स तमायान्तमब्रवीत् ।मोघं कर्तुं न शक्यं तु ब्राह्ममस्त्रं तदुच्यताम् ।। ५.३८.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: paridyūnaṁ viṣaṇṇaṁ ca sa tamāyāntamabravīt ।moghaṁ kartuṁ na śakyaṁ tu brāhmamastraṁ taducyatām ।। 5.38.36।।।।

translations.english: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.

verses.sloka: हिनस्तु दक्षिणाक्षि त्वच्छर इत्यथ सो ऽब्रवीत् ।ततस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम् ।दत्त्वा स दक्षिणं नेत्रं प्राणेभ्यः परिरक्षितः ।। ५.३८.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: hinastu dakṣiṇākṣi tvacchara ityatha so 'bravīt ।tatastasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam ।dattvā sa dakṣiṇaṁ netraṁ prāṇebhyaḥ parirakṣitaḥ ।। 5.38.37।।।।

translations.english: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.

verses.sloka: स रामाय नमस्कृत्वा राज्ञे दशरथाय च ।विसृष्टस्तेन वीरेण प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम् ।। ५.३८.३८।।णम् ।।।
verses.transliteration: sa rāmāya namaskṛtvā rājñe daśarathāya ca ।visṛṣṭastena vīreṇa pratipede svamālayam ।। 5.38.38।।ṇam ।।।

translations.english: 'That crow offered salutations to you Rama and king Dasaratha, thereafter took permission and went to his own dwelling.

verses.sloka: मत्कृते काकमात्रे तु ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरितम् ।कर्माद्यो मां हरत्त्वत्तः क्षमसे तं महीपते ।। ५.३८.३९।।।।
verses.transliteration: matkṛte kākamātre tu brahmāstraṁ samudīritam ।karmādyo māṁ harattvattaḥ kṣamase taṁ mahīpate ।। 5.38.39।।।।

translations.english: '(Addressing Rama as though he was present before her, Sita said) 'O lord of the earth for my sake you released the weapon of Brahma on a crow. What makes you excuse him who has abducted me?

verses.sloka: स कुरुष्व महोत्साहः कृपां मयि नरर्षभ ।त्वया नाथवती नाथ ह्यनाथा इव दृश्यते ।। ५.३८.४०।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa kuruṣva mahotsāhaḥ kṛpāṁ mayi nararṣabha ।tvayā nāthavatī nātha hyanāthā iva dṛśyate ।। 5.38.40।।।।

translations.english: 'O bull among men you are so loving to me. I am like an orphan. Be kind to me. She who has found her lord in you stays without a protector.

verses.sloka: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्त्वत्त एव मया श्रुतः ।। ५.३८.४१।।।।
verses.transliteration: ānṛśaṁsyaṁ paro dharmastvatta eva mayā śrutaḥ ।। 5.38.41।।।।

translations.english: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.

verses.sloka: जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम् ।अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात् सागरोपमम् ।भर्तारं ससमुद्रायाधरण्या वासवोपमम् ।। ५.३८.४२।।।।
verses.transliteration: jānāmi tvāṁ mahāvīryaṁ mahotsāhaṁ mahābalam ।apārapāramakṣobhyaṁ gāmbhīryāt sāgaropamam ।bhartāraṁ sasamudrāyādharaṇyā vāsavopamam ।। 5.38.42।।।।

translations.english: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.

verses.sloka: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठः सत्यवान् बलवानपि ।किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयति राघवः ।। ५.३८.४३।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamastravidāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ satyavān balavānapi ।kimarthamastraṁ rakṣassu na yojayati rāghavaḥ ।। 5.38.43।।।।

translations.english: 'Even though you are an expert in the use of weapons, truthful and strong. (Yet) why are you not using weapons aganst the demons?'

verses.sloka: न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः ।रामस्य समरे वेगं शक्ताः प्रतिसमाधितुम् ।। ५.३८.४४।।।।
verses.transliteration: na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ ।rāmasya samare vegaṁ śaktāḥ pratisamādhitum ।। 5.38.44।।।।

translations.english: (Now Sita turns to Hanuman and says) "In war serpents, gandharvas, demons or Marutas cannot withstand the speed of Rama's arrows and hit back.

verses.sloka: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद् यद्यस्ति मयि संभ्रमः ।किमर्थं न शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षयं नयति राक्षसान् ।। ५.३८.४५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya vīryavataḥ kaścid yadyasti mayi saṁbhramaḥ ।kimarthaṁ na śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kṣayaṁ nayati rākṣasān ।। 5.38.45।।।।

translations.english: "Does Rama have a little anxiety about me? If he has, why does he, a disciplined hero, not put an end to the demons with his sharp arrows?

verses.sloka: भ्रातुरादेशमादाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः ।कस्य हेतोर्न मां वीरः परित्राति महाबलः ।। ५.३८.४६।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhrāturādeśamādāya lakṣmaṇo vā parantapaḥ ।kasya hetorna māṁ vīraḥ paritrāti mahābalaḥ ।। 5.38.46।।।।

translations.english: "Or, why does the mighty hero, Lakshmana, who is a scorcher of enemies, not come to my rescue taking the orders from his brother?

verses.sloka: यदि तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ ।सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः ।। ५.३८.४७।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi tau puruṣavyāghrau vāyvagnisamatejasau ।surāṇāmapi durdharṣau kimarthaṁ māmupekṣataḥ ।। 5.38.47।।।।

translations.english: "Both Rama and Lakshmana are tigers among men who resemble wind and fire in power and have the unassailability of the gods. Wherefore are they disregarding me?.

verses.sloka: ममैव दुष्कृतं किंचिन्महदस्ति न संशयः ।समर्थावपि तौ यन्मां नावेक्षते परन्तपौ ।। ५.३८.४८।।।।
verses.transliteration: mamaiva duṣkṛtaṁ kiṁcinmahadasti na saṁśayaḥ ।samarthāvapi tau yanmāṁ nāvekṣate parantapau ।। 5.38.48।।।।

translations.english: "Perhaps I must have committed an atrocious sin. There is no doubt. For although both of them are scorchers of enemies, they deliver me not."

verses.sloka: वैदह्या वचनं श्रत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम् ।अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ।। ५.३८.४९।।।।
verses.transliteration: vaidahyā vacanaṁ śratvā karuṇaṁ sāśrubhāṣitam ।athābravīnmahātejā hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ।। 5.38.49।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the piteous words of Vaidehi and beholding her eyes filled with tears, the Windgod's son, lustrous Hanuman replied thus:.

verses.sloka: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन मे शपे ।रामे दुःखाभिपन्ने च लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ।। ५.३८.५०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena me śape ।rāme duḥkhābhipanne ca lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate ।। 5.38.50।।।।

translations.english: "O godlike lady Rama is not averse to your misery. On my word this is true. Rama is immersed in sorrow. Even Lakshmana wails.

verses.sloka: कथंचिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम् ।। ५.३८.५१।।।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁcidbhavatī dṛṣṭā na kālaḥ pariśocitum ।। 5.38.51।।।।

translations.english: "I could find you with difficulty. This is not the time to wail. O blameless lady take it, your sorrow has come to an end at this moment.

verses.sloka: इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानां द्रक्ष्यस्यन्तमनिन्दिते ।तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रौ महाबलौ ।। ५.३८.५२।।।।
verses.transliteration: imaṁ muhūrtaṁ duḥkhānāṁ drakṣyasyantamanindite ।tāvubhau puruṣavyāghrau rājaputrau mahābalau ।। 5.38.52।।।।

translations.english: "Both the mighty brothers, tigers among men, are eager to see you. Both the princes will reduce this Lanka into ashes.

verses.sloka: त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः ।। ५.३८.५३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhau laṅkāṁ bhasmīkariṣyataḥ ।। 5.38.53।।।।

translations.english: "O largeeyed lady cruel Ravana along with his relatives will be killed by Rama in war and Rama will return to his city with you.

verses.sloka: हत्वा च समरे क्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम् ।राघवस्त्वां विशालाक्षि नेष्यति स्वां पुरीं प्रति ।ब्रूहि यद्राघवो वाच्यो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः ।। ५.३८.५४।।।।
verses.transliteration: hatvā ca samare krūraṁ rāvaṇaṁ sahabāndhavam ।rāghavastvāṁ viśālākṣi neṣyati svāṁ purīṁ prati ।brūhi yadrāghavo vācyo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ ।। 5.38.54।।।।

translations.english: "Communicate your message to mighty Rama and Lakshamana, to brilliant Sugriva and even the vanaras who gather there.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवो वापि तेजस्वी हरयो ऽपि समागताः ।इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंश्च सीता सुरसुतोपमा ।उवाच सोकसन्तप्ता हनुमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम् ।। ५.३८.५५।।।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvo vāpi tejasvī harayo 'pi samāgatāḥ ।ityuktavati tasmiṁśca sītā surasutopamā ।uvāca sokasantaptā hanumantaṁ plavaṅgamam ।। 5.38.55।।।।

translations.english: "Hanuman having spoken this way, Sita, resembling a god's daughter, grieving, thus addressed Hanuman:

verses.sloka: कौसल्या लोकभर्तारं सुषुवे यं मनस्विनी ।तं ममार्थे सुखं पृच्छ शिरसा चाभिवादय ।। ५.३८.५६।।।।
verses.transliteration: kausalyā lokabhartāraṁ suṣuve yaṁ manasvinī ।taṁ mamārthe sukhaṁ pṛccha śirasā cābhivādaya ।। 5.38.56।।।।

translations.english: "Bow to Rama and offer salutations on my behalf. Inquiries concerning his welfare should be addressed to Rama, whom virtuous Kausalya bore as a son.

verses.sloka: स्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गनाः ।ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम् ।। ५.३८.५७।।।।
verses.transliteration: srajaśca sarvaratnāni priyā yāśca varāṅganāḥ ।aiśvaryaṁ ca viśālāyāṁ pṛthivyāmapi durlabham ।। 5.38.57।।।।

translations.english: He by whom Sumitra became a blessed mother—who, honouring and gladly taking leave of his father and mother, renounced garlands, all jewels, beloved women, and a sovereignty rare upon this vast earth to follow Rama into exile.

verses.sloka: पितरं मातरं चैव संमान्याभिप्रसाद्य च ।अनुप्रव्रजितो रामं सुमित्रा येन सुप्रजाः ।। ५.३८.५८।।।।
verses.transliteration: pitaraṁ mātaraṁ caiva saṁmānyābhiprasādya ca ।anupravrajito rāmaṁ sumitrā yena suprajāḥ ।। 5.38.58।।।।

translations.english: He by whom Sumitra became a blessed mother—who, honouring and gladly taking leave of his father and mother, renounced garlands, all jewels, beloved women, and a sovereignty rare upon this vast earth to follow Rama into exile.

verses.sloka: आनुकूल्येन धर्मात्मा त्यक्त्वा सुखमनुत्तमम् ।अनुगच्छति काकुत्स्थं भ्रातरं पालयन् वने ।। ५.३८.५९।।।।
verses.transliteration: ānukūlyena dharmātmā tyaktvā sukhamanuttamam ।anugacchati kākutsthaṁ bhrātaraṁ pālayan vane ।। 5.38.59।।।।

translations.english: "Great, righteous Lakshmana had given up his pleasures and followed his brother Rama in his favour into the forest to be able to serve him.

verses.sloka: संहस्कन्धो महाबाहुर्मनस्वी प्रियदर्शनः ।पितृवद्वर्तते रामे मातृवन्मां समाचरन् ।। ५.३८.६०।।।।
verses.transliteration: saṁhaskandho mahābāhurmanasvī priyadarśanaḥ ।pitṛvadvartate rāme mātṛvanmāṁ samācaran ।। 5.38.60।।।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana, who has lionshoulders and strong arms, who is handsome, who takes Rama as his father and treats me as his own mother.

verses.sloka: ह्रियमाणां तदा वीरो न तु मां वेद लक्ष्मणः ।। ५.३८.६१।।।।
verses.transliteration: hriyamāṇāṁ tadā vīro na tu māṁ veda lakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 5.38.61।।।।

translations.english: "Heroic Lakshmana, did not know while I was borne away. He is prosperous, foremost in serving elders. He is energetic and reserved in his speech like my fatherinlaw. He is a prince dear (to his brother).

verses.sloka: वृद्दोपसेवी लक्ष्मीवान् शक्तो न बहु भाषिता ।राजपुत्रः प्रियः श्रेष्ठः सदृशः श्वशुरस्य मे ।। ५.३८.६२।।।।
verses.transliteration: vṛddopasevī lakṣmīvān śakto na bahu bhāṣitā ।rājaputraḥ priyaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sadṛśaḥ śvaśurasya me ।। 5.38.62।।।।

translations.english: "Rama's brother Lakshmana is always dear to me. Heroic Lakshmana will discharge whichever responsibility is entrusted to him.

verses.sloka: मम प्रियतरो नित्यं भ्राता रामस्य लक्ष्मणः ।नियुक्तो धुरि यस्यां तु तामुद्वहति वीर्यवान् ।। ५.३८.६३।।।।
verses.transliteration: mama priyataro nityaṁ bhrātā rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।niyukto dhuri yasyāṁ tu tāmudvahati vīryavān ।। 5.38.63।।।।

translations.english: "He is Lakshmana for whose care and support Rama did not miss the noble king Dasaratha (during exile). Convey him my words of enquiry about his wellbeing.

verses.sloka: यं दृष्ट्वा राघवो नैव वृत्तमार्यमनुस्मरेत् ।स ममार्थाय कुशलं वक्तव्यो वचनान्मम ।मृदुर्नित्यं शुचिर्दक्षः प्रियो रामस्य लक्ष्मणः ।। ५.३८.६४।।।।
verses.transliteration: yaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāghavo naiva vṛttamāryamanusmaret ।sa mamārthāya kuśalaṁ vaktavyo vacanānmama ।mṛdurnityaṁ śucirdakṣaḥ priyo rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 5.38.64।।।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana is soft, pure, competent and dear to Rama. O great vanara, act in such a manner that Lakshmana can mitigate my suffering. O great monkey, the best of vanaras you are competent in accomplishing this task.

verses.sloka: यथा हि वानरश्रेष्ठ दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत् ।त्वमस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तम ।। ५.३८.६५।।।।
verses.transliteration: yathā hi vānaraśreṣṭha duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet ।tvamasmin kāryaniryoge pramāṇaṁ harisattama ।। 5.38.65।।।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana is soft, pure, competent and dear to Rama. O great vanara, act in such a manner that Lakshmana can mitigate my suffering. O great monkey, the best of vanaras you are competent in accomplishing this task.

verses.sloka: राघवस्त्वत्समारम्भान्मयि यत्नपरो भवेत् ।। ५.३८.६६।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavastvatsamārambhānmayi yatnaparo bhavet ।। 5.38.66।।।।

translations.english: "By your efforts alone my husband will try for my release. You may tell these words to my heroic husband, Rama, again and again.

verses.sloka: इदं ब्रूयाश्च मे नाथं शूरं रामं पुनः पुनः ।जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज ।। ५.३८.६७।।।।
verses.transliteration: idaṁ brūyāśca me nāthaṁ śūraṁ rāmaṁ punaḥ punaḥ ।jīvitaṁ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṁ daśarathātmaja ।। 5.38.67।।।।

translations.english: "I will hold on to life only for a month. Beyond, I will not survive. I swear by truth. You may tell this to Rama.

verses.sloka: ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं सत्येनाहं ब्रवीमि ते ।रावणेनोपरुद्धां मां निकृत्या पापकर्मणा ।। ५.३८.६८।।।।
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṁ māsānna jīveyaṁ satyenāhaṁ bravīmi te ।rāvaṇenoparuddhāṁ māṁ nikṛtyā pāpakarmaṇā ।। 5.38.68।।।।

translations.english: "O heroic Rama just as Kausik was rescued from the underworld it behoves you to deliver me from imprisonment of wicked Ravana".

verses.sloka: त्रातुमर्हसि वीर त्वं पातालादिव कौशिकीम् ।ततो वस्त्रगतं मुक्त्वा दिव्यं चूडामणिं शुभम् ।प्रदेयो राघवायेति सीता हनुमते ददौ ।। ५.३८.६९।।।।
verses.transliteration: trātumarhasi vīra tvaṁ pātālādiva kauśikīm ।tato vastragataṁ muktvā divyaṁ cūḍāmaṇiṁ śubham ।pradeyo rāghavāyeti sītā hanumate dadau ।। 5.38.69।।।।

translations.english: Then Sita took out the exquisite and auspicious Chudamani worn on the head, untied from her clothes and gave it to Hanuman to be presented to Rama.

verses.sloka: प्रतिगृह्य ततो वीरो मणिरत्नमनुत्तमम् ।अङ्गुल्या योजयामास न ह्यस्य प्राभवद्भुजः ।।। ५.३८.७०।।।।
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhya tato vīro maṇiratnamanuttamam ।aṅgulyā yojayāmāsa na hyasya prābhavadbhujaḥ ।।। 5.38.70।।।।

translations.english: Then Hanuman, taking the extraordinary jewel and placed it on his finger as it was not fitting to his arm.

verses.sloka: मणिरत्नं कपिवरः प्रतिगृह्याभिवद्य च ।सीतां प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रणतः पार्श्वतः स्थितः ।। ५.३८.७१।।।।
verses.transliteration: maṇiratnaṁ kapivaraḥ pratigṛhyābhivadya ca ।sītāṁ pradakṣiṇaṁ kṛtvā praṇataḥ pārśvataḥ sthitaḥ ।। 5.38.71।।।।

translations.english: Having recieved the jewel from Sita and circumambulated her, Hanuman offered salutations to her and stood by her.

verses.sloka: हर्षेण महता युक्तः सीतादर्शनजेन सः ।हृदयेन गतो रामं शरीरेण तु विष्ठितः ।। ५.३८.७२।।।।
verses.transliteration: harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sītādarśanajena saḥ ।hṛdayena gato rāmaṁ śarīreṇa tu viṣṭhitaḥ ।। 5.38.72।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman stood there physically, with great joy gazing at Sita, but mentally he was with Rama.

verses.sloka: मणिवरमुपगृह्य तं महार्हं जनकनृपात्मजया धृतं प्रभावात् ।गिरिरिव पवनावधूत्मुक्तः सुखितमनाः प्रतिसंक्रमं प्रपेदे ।। ५.३८.७३।।
verses.transliteration: maṇivaramupagṛhya taṁ mahārhaṁ janakanṛpātmajayā dhṛtaṁ prabhāvāt ।giririva pavanāvadhūtmuktaḥ sukhitamanāḥ pratisaṁkramaṁ prapede ।। 5.38.73।।

translations.english: Having received the most precious jewel from the daughter of Janaka, Hanuman prepared to return like a mountain released from the impact of the wind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
